entry_state: The account mapping, affine method comparison, ordered substitution and exact region partition establish different parts of a continuous accounting result. A point proves a region nonempty but not the formula throughout it. Certified completion still leaves the policy question: actions must agree across histories indistinguishable to the manager.
exit_state: Policy feasibility uses the manager's full observation history and reachable decisions. Source selection additionally depends on actor access, publication, ingestion, review and effective time. Exact temporal partitions retain alternative information views without inventing clock probabilities; sharing their identical calculations must preserve their distinct source supports.

observations.finding: Second decisions use pre-payment cash and remembered observations/actions; future rates and hidden facility rights are not supplied as signals. Intersection and Boolean-constraint formulations retain complete feasible policies. Only receipt7/refined signal/committed-right has four policies; coarse information, absent rights and later repayment shortfall fail for distinct reasons.
observations.disposition: retain the three failure causes and absence of a preference ranking or forecast probability

observations.finding: An actor decision cutoff differs from the system reconstruction cutoff. Known late corrections cannot be inserted into an earlier actor view; a later system can reconstruct previously accessible facts. Unique eligible revision heads, unresolved times, incomparable corrections and retraction have distinct outcomes. Same-meaning source replacements preserve policy numbers while changing evidence bindings.
observations.disposition: retain explicit clock semantics and selected-profile limits; a hash does not establish source truth

observations.finding: Half-open access ranges preserve whether a decision at an endpoint may precede access. Public retrieval and private delivery have different chronology constraints; an older fixture inconsistent with public retrieval is explicitly diagnosed. Difference inequalities and first-failure complements partition all admitted clock assignments. Original-edge cycle sums and rational witnesses distinguish impossibility from nonemptiness.
observations.disposition: retain exact boundary logic and route change as a changed question; no clock distribution is inferred

observations.finding: A correction interval can retain a no-feasible-policy view and a four-policy view. Choosing only the latter loses a possible information structure. Numerical sharing preserves all source supports; common policy construction requires comparable actor observations and actions across mechanisms.
observations.disposition: retain both timing views and continue the cross-mechanism policy discussion
